releaseNotes: v0.2.8 (beta): The tile reads cleanly on the device page too (Online and the filter and brush values no longer split across lines). v0.2.7 (beta): The dashboard tile now appears right after turning it on (it waited for the vacuum's status to change). v0.2.6 (beta): New dashboard tile. Turn on Dashboard tile on the vacuum and add an Attribute tile with the tile attribute for a health card: status, battery, online, errors, last clean, progress or filter and brush life. v0.2.5 (beta): Clean area in square meters for metric users: the Area unit preference follows the hub by default (Celsius hub: square meters), and the attribute reads cleanArea (sq m) instead of a square-meter value under cleanArea (sq ft). Square-foot users see no change. v0.2.4 (beta): Start, Pause, Resume and Dock are one Vacuum Control command (update rules and Maker API calls). switch follows what the vacuum is doing, so a Qrevo MaxV no longer shows on while docked. The local key is no longer in State Variables. Refresh logs what changed. Rescan waits 5 minutes between scans and explains Roborock's too many requests error; a Sign in again banner when Roborock rejects the saved sign-in; Rescan flags vacuums no longer in the account. Quieter logs when a vacuum is just off. New Tips for moving from bloodtick's driver and for a vacuum that stays offline; Tips opens at the top. v0.2.3 (beta): After an update or Repair, vacuums reconnect on their own within about 30 seconds. Before, the connection was dropped silently and stayed down (healthStatus still said online) until Initialize. Done in the app and Diagnostics also reconnect a vacuum that isn't connected. v0.2.2 (beta): Remaining Filter now matches the Roborock app (it read the dock strainer counter before). Saros water flow shows the app's name in mopWaterMode plus the slider number in the new mopWaterLevel. roomsList and scenesList read ( Name: ID ). Each vacuum has a help link to Tips & Troubleshooting. README has a command table for moving from bloodtick's driver. Execute is documented in Tips and the README. v0.2.1 (beta): Brings back everything from 0.2.0 (Diagnostics button, IP recovery, MAC on the device page, Tips page) that the 0.1.3 sign-in update accidentally replaced, and keeps the 0.1.3 sign-in fix (current Roborock login with the user agreement version, clearer sign-in messages). v0.2.0 (beta): Automatic IP recovery. If a vacuum's IP changes, the app finds the new one through Roborock's cloud, checks the MAC matches, and reconnects locally. Adds a small hidden Roborock Cloud Helper device that only connects during a lookup. The vacuum's MAC now shows on its device page and card for setting a DHCP reservation. v0.1.5 (beta): New Tips & Troubleshooting page in the app, starting with exactly what runs locally and what still needs the Roborock cloud. v0.1.4 (beta): Diagnostics button on the vacuum device logs model, firmware, protocol and the raw status in one block for testers to send. Full logging stays on for 3 hours during the beta. v0.1.3 (beta): Quieter reconnects. The vacuum closes its local connection now and then; the driver now reconnects within a few seconds and only shows offline if it stays down for 90 s. A command sent while reconnecting is sent once connected. v0.1.0 (beta): First build. Local control of Roborock vacuums over the vacuum's own TCP port, no cloud after a one-time sign-in. Supports the newer L01 protocol (Qrevo Curv and similar) and the older 1.0 protocol. Attribute and command names match bloodtick's Roborock driver so existing rules carry over.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Roborock Integration
apps.description: Signs in to Roborock once to bring in your vacuums, their local keys and room names, and creates a device for each.

drivers.name: Roborock Vacuum
drivers.description: One vacuum, controlled locally: status, start, dock, pause, room cleaning, fan and mop modes, consumables.

drivers.name: Roborock Cloud Helper
drivers.description: Hidden helper, one per account. Only connects to Roborock's cloud to find a vacuum's new IP after it changes.
